answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 2817 Country: QA Title: I am mother of two small daughters. i often dream that i am in a crowded place and my kids get lost in the crowd.i am very worried. Please, can you help me? Question: I am mother of two small daughters. i often dream that i am in a crowded place and my kids get lost in the crowd.i am very worried. Please, can you help me? Answer ID: 2817 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 328/239=H) This is not a dream but satanic insinuation. Keep the habit of reciting Ayatul Kursi and Dua-e-Masoor at bedtime with wuzu . Also, recite Ayatul Kursi after every obligatory salah and blow on your chest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
